critical_concepts.definition: Imaginary lines used to divide the body into sections.
Functional groups of organs working together.

interactive_questions.title: Organ Systems
interactive_questions.prompt: Identify the primary function of the organ system.
interactive_questions.question: Which system is responsible for the transport of nutrients and oxygen?
interactive_questions.explanation: The cardiovascular system pumps blood throughout the body to deliver oxygen and nutrients to tissues.

theory.title: Interactive Anatomy
theory.content: Explore the human body and brain structure in this interactive module. Click on different organs to learn about their function, clinical significance, and anatomical details.
theory.analogy: The human body is like a complex city with different districts (systems) working together to keep the city functioning.
theory.application: Understanding anatomical relationships is crucial for surgery and diagnosing referred pain.
